title: add-transactional-downgrade-guard-backup-restore-version-pinning-schema-migrations-private-installer
author: Maya Thompson
body: Motivation: private deployments have seen incidents during operator-driven upgrades where partial schema migrations or mixed-version components allowed rolling back to an incompatible state. This PR adds a transactional downgrade guard, tightens version pinning across the helm chart and terraform modules, and improves backup/restore verification to ensure recoverability before allowing automatic rollbacks. Changes include a pre-upgrade validation step that snapshots Postgres schema version and WAL position, a post-upgrade verification that runs the restore path to an ephemeral namespace, and a new Helm hook that gates upgrade completion until schema migrations report success. The change is conservative and off by default for existing clusters; operators can opt-in via helm value upgrade.guards.enabled=true. Backwards compatibility: installer supports clusters with older image tags but will refuse automated rollback without explicit force flag. See linked Linear tickets ENG-8273 and ENG-8289 for scope and rollout plan.
commits: add transactional downgrade guard and validation scaffolding
implement schema migration reporter and helm hook for migration gating
add version pinning matrix to helm/Chart.yaml and terraform/provider.tf
backup/restore: add pre-upgrade snapshot + automatic restore smoke test
tests: add e2e restore verification and migration failure simulation
docs: document upgrade/rollback flow and operator opt-in flag
review_threads: Anika Patel: Please explain how the guard behaves if an operator forces rollback. Author: The guard will block automatic rollback paths; forced rollbacks require --force and create a safe-mode marker in the cluster which requires manual DB restore confirmation.

Diego Ramos: Integration tests failed once on migration timeout, can we add a retry? Author: Added a retry loop and bump to the migration timeout in values.yaml; test updated to simulate transient lock contention.

Ellen Park: Does version pinning affect air-gapped customers? Author: Added a values.yaml note and terraform variable to override pinning for air-gapped installs; default pins are suggested curated images to avoid accidental roll-forward during mixed upgrades.
QA: Verified restore smoke test in ephemeral namespace on CI and recorded timings. Author: Verified and included a recovery benchmark in the docs.
release_notes: Added transactional downgrade guard for private-installer that prevents automated rollback when schema migrations are incomplete; improved backup/restore verification and introduced version-pinning for helm and terraform modules. Operators must opt-in to the guard via helm values. See docs/private-installer/upgrade-rollback.md for migration steps and rollback runbook.
